_comment: Bundle-size budgets in gzipped kB (REQUIREMENTS.md §13.5). Enforced by
`npm run budget`, which CI runs after the build — a regression fails the
build rather than being noticed later.
Groups are filename prefixes, not exact names: Vite fingerprints its output.
Raising a budget is fine when the growth is deliberate — do it in the same
commit as the change, so the increase is reviewed alongside what caused it.
_w1_note: assets/index went 108 -> 112 with W1.1-W1.5 — see the note in Work's
bundle-budget.json; the growth is the same shared code.
